channels.name: Dataflow
channels.active_levels: MCmd/MAddr/MData/MByteEn master->slave; SCmdAccept/SResp/SData slave->master; MRespAccept master->slave

global_signals.name: Clk
global_signals.purpose: OCP clock; all signals (except Reset_n / async interrupt/error) sampled on its rising edge.

global_signals.name: Reset_n
global_signals.purpose: Active-low reset; interface held idle while asserted.

handshake_pairs.name: MCmd/SCmdAccept
handshake_pairs.rule: Request phase: completes when MCmd is valid and SCmdAccept is asserted.

handshake_pairs.name: MDataValid/SDataAccept
handshake_pairs.rule: Datahandshake phase: write-data beat accepted when both are asserted.

handshake_pairs.name: SResp/MRespAccept
handshake_pairs.rule: Response phase: completes when SResp is non-NULL and MRespAccept is asserted.

handshake_pairs.name: SThreadBusy/MThreadBusy
handshake_pairs.rule: Per-thread back-pressure without stalling the whole socket.

dependency_graph.common_rule: All OCP signals (except Reset_n and async interrupt/error) are synchronous to Clk and respect Reset_n. The request phase depends on SCmdAccept; the datahandshake phase on SDataAccept; the response phase on MRespAccept.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: SData (read) depends on an accepted RD request and the slave's latency; the datahandshake write beat depends on MDataValid + SDataAccept; thread progress depends on SThreadBusy/MThreadBusy.

logical_signaling_levels.name: request accepted
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: MCmd valid and SCmdAccept asserted on the same edge.

logical_signaling_levels.name: request wait
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: SCmdAccept deasserted; master holds the request.

logical_signaling_levels.name: write-data beat accepted
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: MDataValid and SDataAccept asserted on the same edge.

logical_signaling_levels.name: response accepted
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: SResp non-NULL and MRespAccept asserted on the same edge.

logical_signaling_levels.name: thread busy
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: SThreadBusy/MThreadBusy asserted; the thread cannot accept a transfer.

ordering_rules.intra_thread: Within a single thread, transfers complete in order unless tags (MTagID/STagID) permit out-of-order responses.
ordering_rules.inter_thread: Across threads (MThreadID/SThreadID) there is no ordering constraint; responses may interleave.
ordering_rules.connection: MConnID identifies the initiator connection for QoS/security/routing.
